turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We don’t currently ship internationally outside of North America.

Here’s how it works right now:

• We ship within the contiguous United States. • We also ship select products to Alaska and Hawaii. • We ship select items to limited regions within Canada.

For customs, duties, and taxes: • For Canadian orders, all prices are shown in CAD and already include duties and taxes in the listed price. There are no extra customs or duty bills later; everything is handled upfront at checkout. • For U.S. orders, you simply pay the item total, shipping, and any applicable sales tax at checkout.

If you tell me which country you’re in (or hoping to ship to), I can confirm what’s possible for that location.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

For most orders, transit time is typically about 1–5 business days once your order leaves our nursery.

A couple of helpful details:

At checkout, you’ll see a delivery calendar where you can choose your estimated arrival date (for U.S. addresses) based on our processing time plus carrier transit time to you.
We ship by standard ground service; we don’t offer same-day or express shipping.
You’ll receive an email with tracking as soon as your order ships so you can follow its progress.

If you share what you’re planning to order (roses, bulbs, or perennials) and your state or province, I can give you a more tailored expectation for timing.
